note: Suppressions for scripts/audit-gate.mts. Every entry is a decision someone has to make again on its expiry date: an entry past `expires` FAILS the build, exactly like an unreviewed advisory. Deleting an expired entry without re-reading it is the failure mode this file exists to make visible, so keep the reason specific enough that the next reader can check it.

resolved.sharp GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj: Entry removed 2026-08-02, fixed rather than expired. It argued that sharp >=0.35.0 could not be taken because next 16.2.12 declares optionalDependencies.sharp '^0.34.5', and that forcing it through an npm override was a 0.x major bump it would not risk. The bump was then tried on Pulse, which runs the identical next 16.2.12, and it built clean; it was tried here and typecheck, lint, 226 unit tests, 10 eval tests and a production build all passed on sharp 0.35.3. The caution was reasonable and it was also untested, which is the part worth remembering: an unverified risk was allowed to hold a high advisory open for months. next.config.ts still sets images.unoptimized, so the reachability argument stands as well; it is now a second line of defence behind a real fix instead of the only one.
